description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up of two triangular traffic signs mounted on a metal pole against a clear blue sky. The top sign is red-bordered with a white background and features a black circular arrow symbol, indicating a roundabout ahead. Above this sign is a black rectangular device, possibly a solar panel or sensor, attached to the pole. Below the roundabout sign is another triangular sign with a red border and a white background, displaying a black silhouette of a bicycle, warning of a bicycle
